rows.value: 25% overall residential exemption, 4% cap on increases in value, 50% long-term homeowner exemption
rows.note: Described as existing law by the Legislative Service Office (Nov. 2025). The long-term homeowner exemption was amended in 2026; eligibility rules not stored.
